title: Firebase realtime dashboard adapter
summary: Optional realtime team dashboard adapter that mirrors DontPanic state projection into Firebase and routes dashboard mutations through DontPanic MCP.

auth: gcloud application-default credentials or service account for deploy
config: Firebase web app config for dashboard

verify.readiness: Core/static dashboard does not require Firebase. This adapter is ready only when Firebase project, auth, rules/functions deploy access, and local MCP mutation path are configured.

adapter: Cloud Functions that call DontPanic MCP

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: Dashboard action -> Cloud Function -> DontPanic MCP mutating tool with confirm=true. Firestore mirrors projection state and is not the source of truth.
forbidden: Browser writes that directly mutate plan/gate/signoff state
Cloud Functions writing DontPanic local state without MCP
Making Firebase a requirement for core onboarding

notes: Static dashboard is core and has no Firebase dependency.
Firebase Hosting may host static files, but Firebase realtime behavior is an optional adapter.

setup_steps.what: Install the Firebase CLI so the operator can deploy rules and Cloud Functions.
Install the gcloud CLI so the operator can manage service accounts and deploy credentials.
Authenticate the Firebase CLI against the operator's Google account.
setup_steps.human_required_reason: Requires interactive browser sign-in with the operator's Google account; DontPanic cannot proxy this consent.

setup_steps.what: Authenticate gcloud and set application-default credentials for deploys.
setup_steps.command_template: gcloud auth login && gcloud auth application-default login
setup_steps.human_required_reason: Requires interactive browser sign-in; the operator must approve cloud platform scopes.

setup_steps.what: Point the local Firebase config at the operator's target Firebase project.
Deploy the dashboard Firestore rules so the mirror collection enforces read-only browser access.
Deploy the Cloud Functions that proxy dashboard mutations through the DontPanic MCP server.
Start the local MCP bridge process the Cloud Functions call back into for mutations.
Trigger a deployed dashboard action end-to-end per dashboard/functions/RUNBOOK.md section 5.
setup_steps.human_required_reason: Requires a deployed Firebase project, an authenticated dashboard session, a running tunnel to the local MCP bridge, and a real dashboard action; DontPanic v0 does not ship an automated firebase-dashboard smoke runner.
